about_the_game:
Age of Fear: The World Map

A print-ready Age of Fear world map - feel free to use in your role-playing sessions or just hung it on the wall. As a humble gift for our supporters!
  • To access the world map after purchase go to the same folder where you can find Age of Fear folder (Game Library>Properties>Browse Local Files...). All items are in Extras folder.
  • Update from 16/05/2019 - the World Map has been replaced with an extended version (ca. 80% more space). More details can be found here:
